featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this branch while searching for Bravecto, a pet medicine I couldn’t find online or in other stores. My experience here has truly been excellent.

Highlights of my visit:

Bravecto Availability: After visiting multiple stores, this was the only branch that had it in stock.

Great Pricing: The discount I received was better than any online platform.

Premium Accessories: I purchased a leash, harness, and T-shirt for Bella. The quality is outstanding, and everything is extremely comfortable for my little chubby furry kid.

Exclusive Pet Clothing: Their festival collection is impressive in both design and comfort.

Exceptional Customer Service:

A special thanks to Ramandeep, who always assists me and my clients with genuine care.

She makes sure Bella gets the perfect size, even though Bella usually struggles due to her chubby build.

If a size isn’t available, she ensures it is arranged for us within the same day.

Her patience, product knowledge, and supportive attitude make every visit pleasant.

Overall, excellent service, great product availability, and a very supportive staff. Highly recommended for all pet parents!
